items.colloc: participate in 參與 | actively participate 積極參與
items.distinct: attend 出席 | join 加入
ex: Employees should participate in the meeting.
員工應該參加這次會議。
She will participate in the discussion.
她將參與這次討論。
Everyone can participate in the project.
每個人都能參與這項計畫。

items.colloc: reach a consensus 達成共識 | broad consensus 廣泛共識
items.distinct: agreement 同意 | opinion 意見
ex: The team reached a consensus quickly.
團隊很快達成了共識。
We need a consensus on the plan.
我們需要對此計畫達成共識。
No consensus was reached during the talk.
談話過程中未達成共識。

items.colloc: give a briefing 進行簡報 | daily briefing 每日例會
items.distinct: presentation 簡報 | meeting 會議
ex: The manager gave a brief briefing.
經理進行了簡短的說明。
Attend the morning briefing at nine.
九點參加早晨的說明會。
This briefing covers all project updates.
這份簡報涵蓋了所有計畫更新。

items.colloc: collaborate on 合作進行 | collaborate with 與...合作
items.distinct: cooperate 配合 | work 工作
ex: Departments must collaborate on this task.
部門之間必須合作完成此任務。
They collaborate to improve the design.
他們合作以改進設計。
We enjoy collaborating with new partners.
我們樂於與新夥伴合作。

items.colloc: facilitate a meeting 主持會議 | facilitate communication 促進溝通
items.distinct: help 幫助 | assist 協助
ex: Technology can facilitate our daily work.
科技能使我們的日常工作更便利。
He will facilitate the group discussion.
他將主持這場小組討論。
This software facilitates project management.
這套軟體有助於管理專案。

items.colloc: brainstorm ideas 腦力激盪點子 | brainstorming session 腦力激盪會議
items.distinct: discuss 討論 | debate 辯論
ex: Let us brainstorm some creative solutions.
讓我們為創意解決方案腦力激盪。
The team brainstormed for two hours.
團隊進行了兩小時的腦力激盪。
We need to brainstorm future strategies.
我們需要針對未來策略集思廣益。

items.colloc: provide feedback 提供意見 | positive feedback 正面回饋
items.distinct: comment 評論 | review 審查
ex: Please provide feedback on the proposal.
請對該提案提供回饋意見。
Client feedback is very important here.
客戶的意見在這裡非常重要。
We appreciate your honest feedback today.
我們感謝您今天提供的誠實建議。

items.colloc: take minutes 做會議記錄 | review the minutes 審閱會議記錄
items.distinct: note 筆記 | record 紀錄
ex: The secretary took the meeting minutes.
秘書記錄了會議內容。
Please read the minutes from yesterday.
請閱讀昨天的會議記錄。
The minutes are available online now.
會議記錄現在可以在線上查看。

items.colloc: propose a plan 提出計畫 | formally propose 正式提議
items.distinct: suggest 建議 | recommend 推薦
ex: He proposes a new marketing strategy.
他提出了一項新的行銷策略。
They proposed to delay the meeting.
他們提議推遲會議。
The board proposed several key changes.
董事會提議了幾項重大變革。

items.colloc: clarify the issue 釐清問題 | clarify instructions 說明指示
items.distinct: explain 解釋 | define 定義
ex: Can you clarify this point again?
你可以再釐清這點嗎？
The manager clarified the team's roles.
經理釐清了團隊成員的角色。
We must clarify the project goals.
我們必須釐清專案目標。

items.colloc: brief summary 簡要摘要 | executive summary 執行摘要
items.distinct: outline 大綱 | abstract 概要
ex: Read the summary before the meeting.
會議前請閱讀摘要。
The report includes a short summary.
報告中包含了一份簡短摘要。
Provide a summary of the discussion.
提供一份討論內容的總結。

items.colloc: highly negotiable 高度可協商 | price is negotiable 價格可議
items.distinct: flexible 彈性的 | adjustable 可調整的
ex: Our meeting time is still negotiable.
我們的會議時間仍然可以協商。
The terms are negotiable for us.
這些條款對我們來說是可以協商的。
Most aspects of the deal are negotiable.
交易的大多數面向都是可議的。

items.colloc: business prospect 商業前景 | sales prospect 潛在客戶
items.distinct: future 未來 | expectation 期望
ex: The prospect for growth looks good.
成長前景看起來不錯。
We met with a new sales prospect.
我們見了一位新的潛在客戶。
Are there any prospects for expansion?
有擴展業務的前景嗎？

items.colloc: reach a compromise 達成妥協 | work out a compromise 擬定折衷方案
items.distinct: concession 讓步 | settlement 解決方案
ex: We need to reach a compromise.
我們需要達成妥協。
A compromise is better than disagreement.
妥協總比意見不合好。
Both sides compromised on the budget.
雙方在預算上都做了妥協。

items.colloc: adjourn the meeting 宣布散會 | adjourn until tomorrow 推遲至明天
items.distinct: end 結束 | postpone 延期
ex: The chairperson decided to adjourn early.
主席決定提早宣布散會。
We will adjourn the meeting until noon.
我們將休會至中午。
The session adjourned without a decision.
會議在沒有結論的情況下休會。

items.colloc: mandatory meeting 強制參加的會議 | mandatory training 強制訓練
items.distinct: compulsory 義務的 | required 必要的
ex: Attendance is mandatory for all staff.
所有員工必須出席。
This is a mandatory safety briefing.
這是一場強制性的安全說明會。
Is the orientation meeting mandatory?
迎新會議是強制參加的嗎？

items.colloc: allocate time 分配時間 | allocate resources 分配資源
items.distinct: distribute 分發 | assign 指派
ex: We must allocate resources to projects.
我們必須為專案分配資源。
He allocated two hours for discussion.
他為討論撥出了兩小時。
The budget was allocated last month.
預算在上個月已經分配好了。

items.colloc: irrelevant topic 不相關的話題 | totally irrelevant 完全無關
items.distinct: unimportant 不重要的 | trivial 瑣碎的
ex: His comment was irrelevant to us.
他的評論對我們來說不相關。
Avoid bringing up irrelevant issues.
避免提出不相關的問題。
The data provided is largely irrelevant.
所提供的數據很大程度上不相關。

items.colloc: involve in 參與 | directly involve 直接涉及
items.distinct: include 包含 | contain 裝有
ex: The project involves many different departments.
該專案涉及許多不同部門。
He is involved in the planning.
他參與了這項規劃。
These changes involve more costs.
這些變動涉及更多成本。

items.colloc: formal adjournment 正式休會 | move for adjournment 提議休會
items.distinct: postponement 延期 | suspension 中止
ex: The chairman announced the adjournment of the meeting.
主席宣布了會議休會。
We will discuss this after the formal adjournment.
我們將在正式休會後討論。
A brief adjournment was requested by the staff.
員工請求進行短暫休會。
